title: Dangerous Cave
subtitle: Quest: find Tibri's Fire Spear at the bottom of the cave
steps: In the Facility Hub, talk to the Warden who sends you to Tibri's cave (the one with broken speech).
Take the level 20 portal to the Dangerous Cave.
Find Tibri's Fire Spear in the deep levels.
Take the spear back to that Warden for the reward.

notes.title: Quest item
notes.body: The spear is placed in the data, so the route goes straight to it. Tibri the Cavedweller (level 40) is near it.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Banderlings take 0.5 bludgeon, 0.65 pierce and acid, 0.76 slash and cold. Blades and Ogres take 1.32 lightning and 1.08 fire, so lightning is best.

notes.title: Hazards
notes.body: Mostly banderlings of level 15-20, plus Banderling Bandit (level 50) and Tibri (level 40). Four chests sit on the lowest levels.
